description:
Use this when the user wants a community preset for themselves: "add that preset", "save this style to my
        account", "I want the Hype one". preset_id: from browse_presets. Copies the preset into the user's own templates
        in RipClip (a copy that is theirs to keep; adding it twice finds the first copy). A preset that uses a Premium
        feature is added too, but a free plan cannot export it.
        Not for: putting a look on a clip (style_clip with template, which takes the name this returns), sharing the
        user's own preset (done in RipClip) or the user's clipping presets (list_clipping_presets). Costs no Horizon
        Units. Next: style_clip(template=...).
name: add_preset
title: Add a community preset
